# Load libraries

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(readxl)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(biomaRt)
library(CellChat)
```



# Read in data

```{r, include=FALSE}
C26_tumour_RNAseq <- read_excel("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/scIntegration/data/data_tumours/tumours_bulk_RNAseq/GSE253861_C26_norm_count.xlsx")
```



# Make vector describing the experimental conditions and add to metadata (Sample Table)

```{r, include=FALSE}
# 1. Prepare counts matrix
C26_counts_df <- C26_tumour_RNAseq %>%
  select(ENSEMBL, C26_1:C26_4) %>%
  group_by(ENSEMBL) %>%
  summarise(across(C26_1:C26_4, \(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)))

C26_counts <- as.data.frame(C26_counts_df[, -1])
rownames(C26_counts) <- C26_counts_df$ENSEMBL

# 2. Define sample metadata
C26_sample_table <- data.frame(
  sample_name = colnames(C26_counts),
  condition   = factor(rep("C26", ncol(C26_counts)))
)
```



# Filter for log2CPM > 1 in all 4 samples
### NOTE - since these counts are normalized, anything < 0 is actually a count < 1, meaning that it is very lowly expressed.

```{r, include=FALSE}
C26_counts_filtered <- C26_counts[apply(C26_counts, 1, function(x) all(x > 1)), ]
```



# Remove unused objects

```{r, include=FALSE}
rm(C26_counts, C26_counts_df, C26_sample_table)
```



# Get list of genes for "Secreted" proteins from Human Protein Atlas, then map to mouse orthologs

## Filter secreted protein list from HPA
### NOTE - I downloaded a list of HPA.

```{r, include=FALSE}
hpa <- read.delim("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/proteinatlas.tsv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

hpa_secreted <- hpa[grepl("Secreted proteins|Predicted secreted proteins", hpa$Protein.class), ]

# Human secreted gene list
hpa_secreted_genes <- hpa_secreted$Ensembl
```


## Map human genes to mouse orthologs
### NOTE - I downloaded a file from BioMart that converted human genes to mouse orthologs

```{r, include=FALSE}
orthologs <- read.table("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/human_to_mouse_orthologs.txt", header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, sep = "", fill = TRUE)

# Subset for orthology_confidence = 1 (high confidence of gene mapping)
orthologs <- orthologs[orthologs$orthology_confidence == 1, ]

# Filter orthologs for human secreted proteins
orthologs_secreted <- orthologs[orthologs$human_gene_id %in% hpa_secreted_genes, ]

# Filter orthologs for mouse genes
ensembl_secreted <- unique(orthologs_secreted$mouse_gene_id)
```


## Add in gene names and make rownames

```{r, include=FALSE}
# 1. Keep only expressed + secreted genes
C26_secreted <- C26_counts_filtered[rownames(C26_counts_filtered) %in% ensembl_secreted, ]

# 2. Map ENSEMBL IDs to gene symbols for readability
gene_symbols <- mapIds(
  org.Mm.eg.db,
  keys = rownames(C26_secreted),
  keytype = "ENSEMBL",
  column = "SYMBOL",
  multiVals = "first"
)

# 3. Add gene_symbol column
C26_secreted <- data.frame(
  gene_symbol = gene_symbols[rownames(C26_secreted)],
  C26_secreted,
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
```


## Get a list of genes secreted by C26 tumours

```{r, include=FALSE}
C26_secreted_genes <- C26_secreted$gene_symbol
```

```{r, inlcude=FALSE}
write.table(C26_secreted_genes, 
            file = "C26_secreted_genes.csv", 
            row.names = FALSE,
            col.names = FALSE,
            quote = FALSE) 
```



# Get list of matching receptors for secreted genes

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Load the built-in mouse ligand-receptor database
CellChatDB <- CellChatDB.mouse

# Subset the interactions table for ligands in your secreted gene list
lr_C26 <- subset(CellChatDB$interaction, ligand %in% C26_secreted_genes)

# Extract receptors that line up with secreted genes
C26_receptors <- unique(trimws(unlist(strsplit(lr_C26$receptor.symbol, ","))))
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
write.table(C26_receptors, 
            file = "C26_secreted_genes_receptors.csv", 
            row.names = FALSE,
            col.names = FALSE,
            quote = FALSE) 
```
